title: CriteriaService goes dark after a FHIR latency spike
area: gRPC, asyncio cancellation, Cloud Run operations
scenario: A four-minute FHIR store latency spike was followed by a criteria-service outage that outlived it: every call DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, CPU idle, Health still SERVING, fixed only by redeploying the same image. Find out why with the log bundle and a live repro.
task: Reproduce the morning with make repro and read the metrics lines
Find the root cause and explain idle CPU, SERVING health and the restart
Fix server.py without losing per-criterion error handling
acceptance: All permits free after timeouts, errors, deadlines and cancels
CancelledError propagates; concurrency still bounded at 5
Root cause backed by log lines and repro output

practices.label: Week 2 Tue - deadlines, cancellation, status codes
Week 1 Mon - asyncio cancellation and cleanup
Week 2 Wed - the Cloud Run container contract
